label: Genexis XGS2110-2.5G XGS-PON ONT
description: XGS-PON ONT (FiberTwist twist-on connector) with 1× 2.5G LAN and no Wi-Fi; XGS-PON line rate 9.953 Gbit/s symmetric on sc-apc, managed over no published management.
notes: Vendor interface specification: 'WAN interface 1x XGS-PON' and 'LAN interface 1x 2.5GE'. Power supply 12 Vdc ± 5%; consumption 3.2 W idle and 3.2 W on (EU-CoC-BBE). No Wi-Fi, no voice port, no CATV. The 9953 Mbit/s line rate is the ITU-T G.9807.1 convention rather than a vendor figure - the vendor quotes the 2.5 Gbit/s subscriber rate.
